_note: v2 hooks for le Chemin des Gestes (ST_poignees, S02_home), a cobbled lane under cherry trees in spring blossom between lawns and low stone walls with an old street lamp, the gestures street (ST_control seg001-004). Every hook describes what is actually painted (nothing is written in the paintings): Monsieur Verbe the striped mime acts out each verb; the hand mirror marks the reflexive verbs; beret color = verb group.

fr_trembler_verb.why: TREMBLE → trembler = to tremble, to shake (il tremble de peur). RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (tron-BLAY -> trahn-BLAY).

fr_agiter_verb.why: AGITATE → agiter = to shake, to wave, to stir up (agiter le flacon). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_secouer_verb.why: SQUAWK → secouer = to shake (secouer un arbre, secouer la tête). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_pencher_verb.why: PAN → pencher = to lean, to tilt (se pencher par la fenêtre). RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (pon-SHAY -> pahn-SHAY).

fr_tendre_verb.why: TENDER → tendre = to hold out, to stretch out (tendre la main); also an adjective, tender. PURPLE beret = regular -re.

fr_serrer_verb.why: SAY RAY → serrer = to squeeze, to grip (serrer la main = to shake hands). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_lever_verb.why: LEVER → se lever = to get up, to stand up (je me lève à sept heures); lever = to lift, to raise. Reflexive: the mirror; être in compound tenses. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_appuyer_verb.why: APPLE YAY → appuyer = to press, to push (appuyer sur le bouton); to lean, to support. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_trainer_verb.why: TRAIN → traîner = to drag, to pull along; to hang around (traîner une valise). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_charger_verb.why: CHARGE → charger = to load (charger la voiture); to charge (a battery). RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (shar-ZHAY -> shahr-ZHAY).

fr_peser_verb.why: POSY → peser = to weigh (peser les tomates; ça pèse lourd). RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (puh-ZAY -> peuh-ZAY).

fr_interrompre_verb.why: INTERRUPT → interrompre = to interrupt (ne m'interromps pas). GOLD beret = irregular (like rompre: il interrompt). Text pass 2026-10-28 (hook lint): respelling (an-tay-ROMPR) -> (an-teh-ROHNPR) to match the card.

fr_pendre_verb.why: PANDA → pendre = to hang, to hang up (pendre le linge). PURPLE beret = regular -re.
fr_pendre_verb.note: It can also mean to hang a person (an execution), a grim sense.

fr_pousser_verb.why: PUSH → pousser = to push (pousser la porte); to grow (les fleurs poussent). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_presser_verb.why: PRESS → presser = to squeeze, to press (presser un citron); to hurry. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_reposer_verb.why: POSE → se reposer = to rest (je me repose le dimanche); reposer = to put back down. Reflexive: the mirror; être in compound tenses. RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (ruh-po-ZAY -> ruh-poh-ZAY).

fr_ouvrir_verb.why: OOH VERY → ouvrir = to open (ouvrir la porte). GOLD beret = irregular (j'ouvre, ouvert).

fr_ramasser_verb.why: RAM → ramasser = to pick up, to gather (ramasser des pommes). RED beret = regular -er.
